baseline_prompt: Classify a short research note as supported, unsupported, or needs_evidence. Return only the label.

candidate_payload.skill_md: Classify each note with a label and one short evidence reason. Prefer needs_evidence when the note lacks a cited observation.

holdout_cases.input: The pilot improved exact-match accuracy from 0.50 to 0.83 on the attached local CSV.
The method works for every external dataset without further validation.
The new rubric may reduce hallucinations, but no run evidence is attached.
